paths.description: Homepage and quote calculator: primary personal-product landing and conversion entry.
International transfer landing and quote archetype: primary transactional journey.
Business landing archetype: distinct audience, content and commercial journey.
Support article archetype: content, recovery and trust information.
Authentication surface used to inspect form assistance and modern authentication.
Invalid route used to inspect HTTP/runtime recovery.

findings.summary: No dark theme is applied when the system requests one.
findings.evidence: The dark-mode probe matched prefers-color-scheme: dark but reported color-scheme: normal and the same light surface/text palette; the dark screenshot remains light.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven dark surface, text, control and media tokens.

findings.summary: Finite decorative motion continues under reduced-motion.
findings.evidence: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, getAnimations() still reported two running 3,000 ms animations.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable or substantially shorten non-essential animation inside prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

findings.summary: Important state and route changes do not use View Transitions.
findings.evidence: The platform probe found no active route/state transition treatment for the menu/calculator journey, and clicking Send money navigated abruptly.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document or cross-document View Transitions for meaningful state and route changes, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Long pages use static rather than scroll-state-aware navigation chrome.
findings.evidence: Full-page captures exceed 13,000 px while the navigation remains a fixed treatment; no progress or scroll-state response was observed.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a scroll-state container query or lightweight progress/shrinking treatment where it improves orientation.

findings.summary: Cookie consent obscures primary content on entry.
findings.evidence: The help-page mobile screenshot shows a large consent panel and backdrop covering the article immediately on load.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a compact non-modal consent surface where legally possible; preserve content access and equal Accept/Decline actions.

findings.summary: The cookie overlay is not exposed as a dialog or popover.
findings.evidence: DOM probes found zero dialog, role=dialog, or popover elements while screenshots show the consent overlay.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement the overlay with dialog semantics and correct labelling/focus management, or use a non-modal semantic notice.

findings.summary: Some controls lack a visible focus indicator and many targets are undersized.
findings.evidence: The focused first link computed outline was none; the page probe counted 32 rendered controls below 24 px in one dimension.
findings.suggestedFix: Add strong :focus-visible styling and bring interactive targets to an accessible size with spacing.

findings.summary: The measured load is slow and interaction-blocked.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 4.4 s, TBT 640 ms, Speed Index 8.6 s and performance 55; trace corroborated 356 ms TBT.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP resource, reduce startup JavaScript, and schedule non-critical work after rendering.

findings.summary: Long main-thread tasks delay responsiveness.
findings.evidence: The trace recorded four long tasks, including a 318 ms task; mobile layouts recorded tasks up to 366 ms.
findings.suggestedFix: Break long tasks into yieldable chunks, defer analytics/media work, and move suitable computation off-thread.

findings.summary: A large render-critical and media payload is delivered on initial load.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 108 requests and 9.12 MB transferred, including ten parser-inserted very-high-priority stylesheets and 5.94 MB media.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce critical CSS chains, preload only truly critical assets, defer below-fold media, and add missing cache headers.

findings.summary: Large amounts of JavaScript and CSS are unused at load.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found 451 KB unused in the 600 KB app chunk and 184 KB unused CSS (92%) in a 200 KB stylesheet.
findings.suggestedFix: Route-split the app, remove unused styles and load marketing/analytics dependencies conditionally.

findings.summary: Several controls and content structures lack accessible semantics.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found two unnamed carousel buttons, an image without alt, orphan list items and comparison table cells without headers.
findings.suggestedFix: Name icon buttons, add appropriate alt text, restore list containers, and associate every data cell with headers.

findings.summary: Heading order and keyboard focus treatment are inconsistent.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found headings skipping to h5/h4, and the focus probe found no visible outline on the first focused link.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a logical heading hierarchy and a consistent high-contrast :focus-visible indicator.

findings.summary: Touch-target sizing falls below the inclusive baseline.
findings.evidence: Although all four 360 px layouts reflowed without overflow, the probe counted 32 rendered targets under 24 px in one dimension.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase target boxes and spacing while preserving the successful narrow-screen reflow.

findings.summary: The homepage logs rendering and hydration errors.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse captured malformed SVG transform errors and React hydration error #418.
findings.suggestedFix: Correct the SVG transform syntax and eliminate server/client markup divergence causing hydration failure.

findings.summary: Image delivery and sizing are inconsistent.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 42 images without dimensions, 27 without srcset, 8 oversized and 7 legacy-format assets.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve dimensions, provide responsive sources, and modernise remaining raster assets.

findings.summary: The page has platform hygiene regressions.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported missing/403 source maps for large first-party bundles and three BFCache failure reasons tied to no-store responses.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish usable production source maps and review no-store/cookie mutation so eligible public pages can use BFCache.

findings.summary: Some link text is not descriptive out of context.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse SEO identified three “Learn more” links, and the DOM probe counted eight generic Learn more/Find out more links.
findings.suggestedFix: Give each link purpose-specific text or an accessible name that includes its destination.

findings.summary: The sitemap endpoint is not a sitemap.
findings.evidence: robots.txt was available, but /sitemap.xml returned an HTML lost-page response instead of an XML sitemap.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish an XML sitemap and reference it from robots.txt; keep it aligned with canonicals and localized routes.

findings.summary: The help article has no article structured data.
findings.evidence: The help article probe found zero JSON-LD blocks despite the page representing a support article; Open Graph metadata was present.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Article/TechArticle JSON-LD including headline, dates, publisher and canonical URL.

findings.summary: The CSP permits unsafe script execution and Referrer-Policy is absent.
findings.evidence: Headers show HTTPS/HSTS/nosniff, but CSP script-src includes unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval, and no Referrer-Policy header is sent.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unsafe-eval/unsafe-inline using nonces or hashes and set a restrictive Referrer-Policy.

findings.summary: Tracking runs across several third-party origins.
findings.evidence: The tracker probe found six third-party origins and active Mixpanel, Bing and Google Tag Manager trackers; HAR attributed 13 requests and 458 KB to third parties.
findings.suggestedFix: Audit each tracker for necessity, gate optional tracking on consent, and batch/minimise analytics payloads.

findings.summary: Defensive browser policy coverage is incomplete.
findings.evidence: CSP frame-ancestors and HSTS are present, but Referrer-Policy is missing and the permissive CSP includes connect-src * plus unsafe script directives.
findings.suggestedFix: Tighten origin allowlists and add explicit privacy-preserving referrer and feature policies.

findings.summary: Asset selection is not consistently resolution-efficient.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 8 oversized images, 27 without responsive sources and 7 legacy formats.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate modern responsive variants and serve each image close to its rendered size.

findings.summary: Below-fold media and unused code are fetched during initial load.
findings.evidence: HAR transferred 5.94 MB of media and 1.90 MB of script on load while Lighthouse found substantial unused JS/CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer offscreen media and conditional features until user intent or proximity, and remove unused startup work.

findings.summary: The homepage media budget is disproportionate to the primary calculator task.
findings.evidence: Four media requests transferred 5.94 MB, led by a 3.73 MB WebM, before users interacted; total load reached 9.12 MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Use static fallbacks initially, lazy-load video near viewport, and cap third-party/media budgets.

findings.summary: Wise exposes no structured agent-facing transaction capability.
findings.evidence: The site is an agentic-commerce candidate, but recon found only human-facing forms and Lighthouse agentic browsing scored 49 with an ill-formed accessibility tree.
findings.suggestedFix: Expose carefully scoped, confirmable WebMCP tools or agentic forms for quotes and transfer preparation.

findings.summary: The initial JavaScript heap footprint is heavy for a marketing page.
findings.evidence: The baseline heap summary contained 1,126,044 nodes/65.0 MB self size; post-interaction snapshot was 1,191,531 nodes/69.2 MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce eagerly mounted content and code, virtualise/defer below-fold sections, and keep monitoring retained heap.

taskList.title: Cut initial media, JavaScript and critical CSS payload
Repair accessible names, structures, focus and target sizing
Replace the blocking custom cookie overlay with semantic, content-preserving consent UI
Harden CSP and privacy/security policy headers
Fix image sizing and responsive delivery
Repair SEO linking, sitemap and article structured data
Eliminate console, hydration, source-map and BFCache regressions
Prototype safe structured agent tools for quote preparation
